SwitchIngress.update_1.cs_table.reason: Chain-participating SO. Write-site index: mem_index ; hash.get({key}) ; index. Index provenance resolves to PACKET-DERIVED sources (mem_index ; hash.get({key}) ; index  <- packet-derived), so distinct principals collide in one slot: SHARED. partitioned_by stays unset - the index is attacker-influenced.

assume.ref: SketchLib_p4_16_countmin_p416_countmin: no controller in the SketchLib artifact; threshold assumed
assume.reason: SketchLib ships only README.md and compile.sh -- no controller, no entry dump, no threshold value -- so no cp-artifact can be cited. The sketch counter is compared against this control-plane action parameter OUTSIDE the RegisterAction (est = est - threshold, sink keyed on the sign bit), so without pinning it the argument stays free-symbolic and no packet count can be derived. Value 30 is deliberately low: k is replayed as real packets, so a realistic threshold would demand an impractical flood.

auto_facts.note: no match-action tables: CP table assumptions are not applicable

port_authorization.reason: No port authorization exists in the data plane. Recorded explicitly rather than as a pseudo-role 'any': binding concrete ports to such a role would make every write 'authorized' and silently disable privilege-escalation detection.
